snippet.title: Rubber Duck Frontier – Official Trailer | Your TikTok & Twitch chat plays along
snippet.description:
Get Rubber Duck Frontier (Windows PC): https://darudge.gumroad.com/l/rubberduckfrontier
Launch discount: 25% off with code DUCKLAUNCH25 (until 26 October 2026) – https://darudge.gumroad.com/l/rubberduckfrontier/DUCKLAUNCH25

Little ducks. A world of adventure. Rubber Duck Frontier is a cheerful creature-collecting adventure: catch hand-made rubber ducks in soap bubbles, battle in a roaring stadium, record your own quack for every duck and play together with friends.

Made for streamers: your TikTok LIVE and Twitch viewers can trigger 55 in-game events – duck rain, surprise boss fights, thunderstorms, disco and shout-outs – through simple webhook URLs that work with TikFinity, Stream to Earn and any tool that can call a URL. Streaming and monetised videos are allowed.

• Windows 10/11 (64-bit) • 22 languages • Free updates • Licence key per purchase

More info: https://darudge.gumroad.com/rubber-duck-frontier
Website: https://www.darudge.com/interactive
Discord: https://discord.gg/87avFt4H5X
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/darudge_tv
